question: What are earnings, costs and time returns for people who attempt to start publishing on YouTube, including those who never earn?

target_population.entry_event: first attempt to start an owned YouTube publishing channel during a predefined entry window
target_population.exclude_only: ineligible data use; non-consent; genuinely outside the preregistered population

outcomes.scope: YouTube revenue after native platform allocation, before external expenses and taxes
Sponsors, off-platform sales or donations attributable to the endeavor; do not double count YouTube native payouts
Native payout plus external receipts before cash costs
Software, equipment amortization, licenses, subcontracting and other cash costs
Production, learning, editing, marketing, audience work and administration, including unsuccessful attempts
Gross receipts minus cash outlays; may be negative
Only defined when recorded labor hours are positive; never invent a zero-hour rate

existing_evidence_cases.sample_scope: Patreon accounts linked to YouTube affiliation, selected by positive Patreon earnings
existing_evidence_cases.cannot_estimate: all YouTube creators' native payouts, zero-income proportion or profits
new entrant earnings, including channels that never monetize

existing_evidence_cases.sample_scope: Cross-platform self-selected creator survey and a republication of the same respondents
existing_evidence_cases.cannot_estimate: YouTube-only earnings or independent replication from the syndicated article

existing_evidence_cases.sample_scope: Engaged newsletter audience responding to a mixed-platform creator survey
existing_evidence_cases.cannot_estimate: a probability sample of all YouTube entrants or creator net profit

existing_evidence_cases.sample_scope: YouTube inequality research from Germany, Austria and Switzerland; abstract-only review
existing_evidence_cases.cannot_estimate: whole-platform median including zeros without full method review

acceptance_gates.reason: No independently established target-population frame or documented selection probabilities for all new entrants
No collected sample reliably includes inactive, deleted and never-monetized entrants
No representative joint observations of creator payout, off-platform receipts, cash costs and labor hours
No comparable country/entry-period strata and declared FX/price method
No documented nonresponse analysis, survey weights or confidence interval for target population
